column1: # A typed word, a tab, and the foods it means, by code; any member of a food's group counts.
# The meant food is the plain one: the drink or the unprepared food, raw where a table lists raw,
# an "(average)" where a table gives one. Chosen 2026-10-31 by reading the list (foods 2026.10.6).
# English, then French, German and Italian: a word in another language means what its English one does.
